latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-product-launch-coach, an end-to-end coaching tool for teams launching AI-first products.
- Guides founders, PMs, and engineers through critical stages: model/architecture selection, evals & guardrails, unit economics, and defensibility.
- Designed for questions on LLM model choice, prompt vs fine-tune vs RAG, cost/pricing, hallucination & customer trust, vendor lock-in, and safety/regulation.
- Distinct from general SaaS coaching by focusing on AI-specific concerns like eval, model risk, inference cost, and regulatory landscape.
- Includes a detailed diagnostic questionnaire to identify failure modes unique to AI product launches.
